label: L-04
title: harvest.sh cannot decode SYA, strategy, oracle or Router NG reverts, so the operator cannot tell which strategy to exempt (story-005 'readable reason on any simulated revert' unmet)
description: harvest.sh cannot decode SYA, strategy, oracle or Router NG reverts, so the operator cannot tell which strategy to exempt (story-005 'readable reason on any simulated revert' unmet)
impact: None directly; abort-before-send still holds. It removes the operator's means of applying the L-01 workaround: ZeroAmount, NoValidNFT, ExemptStrategyNotRegistered, EnforcedPause, Tokemak InvalidDataReturned print as raw selectors, and Router NG dust reverts print empty data with no token named.
attackPath: Operator runs harvest.sh; the simulation reverts on a strategy-side or router-dust error (L-01 occurs naturally); the script prints a bare selector or nothing; the operator has to guess which strategy to exempt, so harvesting stalls.
likelihood: high - pairs with L-01's natural trigger
assumptions: Operator relies on harvest.sh as shipped.
severityRationale: Resolved flagged question 3 as LOW, split out of the DEDUP-011 bundle. It is not tooling cosmetics. It is an unmet story-005 acceptance criterion (Law 2, F-05), and it is the one thing standing between L-01's natural DoS and its documented workaround, so it has availability consequence. It is not higher than Low because no value is at risk and the transaction is never sent on revert. It gets its own fingerprint so a fix to decode_revert can be reconciled independently of the remaining QA residuals (a, b, d), which keep the parent fingerprint.
recommendation: Add the SYA/strategy/oracle selectors to KNOWN_ERRORS; on empty revert data, re-simulate with each strategy exempted in turn (or call sya.getYield per strategy) and name the offending token.
